notes.title: The "Murder in Paradise" Update is Live!!
notes.notes:
At long last, the Murder in Paradise update for After School Murder Club!! is live!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40574416/aab7bf57e7ac066f1fff13e1a4c44af5cf3d3099.png

This is my homage to the many, many anime that have bonus beach episodes, in which the characters run around in swimsuits and hilarity (and fan service) ensues. It has all the screwball comedy, outdated memes, and royalty-free music that you'd expect from ASMC!!... but this time there are two new characters, and bikinis!

The new scenes should take you around 30 minutes to read through, and there are six new Achievements to unlock too!

You don't need to buy or install anything separately; just update the game to the latest version, and these bonus scenes will be added in automatically. To access them, get to the end of the story's Second Day. When you're given the option to head to the beach, take it! (You can also skip the new scenes entirely; useful if you're replaying the game to get different endings.)

Oh, and please pay attention to the content warning at the start of the new scenes!

As always, thank-you so much for all the downloads, reviews and streams. ASMC!! started as a dumb test game I made for some friends during lockdown, and I never expected so many people to enjoy it. It's embarrassingly amateur in many ways, but it makes me happy to know it's out there in the world, making people laugh (in one way or another).

There are no further plans for major ASMC!! content, but I'll continue to support the game via bugfixes and other little tweaks for the foreseeable future. And I hope you continue to follow Rabbit, Deer, You in my future projects too!

Praise the Teeps!!
